summary: Tested Phase 1 agent onboarding (backend + UI) and the opening-record email. New suite tests/test_v65_agents.py: 21 of 22 pass. The one failure is minor: an invalid ObjectId returns 500. Sealed regression suites (v64, v64b, v64c with the new record_emailed test) pass 66/66 with -n 0. UI: found and fixed one CRITICAL bug. The /agent/join/:token, /agent/login and /agent/me routes were nested inside <RequireAdmin> in App.js, so every agent who opened an invite link was sent to /login?expired=1. I moved the three routes outside RequireAdmin. After that fix the whole UI flow works: admin invite (including duplicate 409 and Resend), join (invalid-token page, password-mismatch toast, httpOnly agent_token cookie), agent login (401 toast on a wrong password, 403 toast when suspended), the 4-step portal (country IN -> state MH -> city datalist -> postcode, bank master shows HDFC, 3 doc uploads + View, 6 consents + sign, submit), admin detail (banking, docs, agreement with IP), clarify (422 without a note), the agent sees the note and resubmits, then approve and suspend. Remaining issues: individual agents are forced to enter a company Registration number (CIN format for India), the X-Forwarded-For header can be spoofed to bypass the lockout, plus several minor UX bugs.

minor.issue: An invalid ObjectId (e.g. 'not-an-objectid') raises bson InvalidId and returns 500. It should return 404/422.

The lockout key is ip:email, and the IP comes from the first X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls. Changing the X-Forwarded-For header on each request gives unlimited 401s and never reaches 429 (verified with 7 tries). Key the lockout on email only, or use the right-most trusted proxy IP.
Returns email_sent:false when the email fails, but the UI ignores it and always shows 'Invitation resent'.

The background task now usually issues the record first, so the record_issued ledger actor and issued_by are the last approving committee member, not the admin. There is also a possible race: an immediate GET record.pdf can run alongside the background _issue_record, and both can write a record_issued audit event before the DuplicateKeyError guard runs. This did not happen in my runs.

Any signed-in vendor or agent can read any agent-docs/ key if they know it. The key holds a UUID, so it is hard to guess. Still, the UI text 'Only PMC reviewers can open them' is not strictly true. Consider an owner check for agent-docs.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the /agent/join/:token, /agent/login and /agent/me routes were inside <Route element={<RequireAdmin/>}>. RequireAdmin calls /admin/auth/me, gets a 401, and redirects to /login, so no agent could join. I moved the routes next to /admin/login.

Individual agents are blocked: 'Registration number' is required and checked against the country company format (India = CIN, e.g. L17110MH1973PLC019786). An individual has no CIN. The form also shows escrow-only fields (Regulator, Licence number/expiry). It has no ID number or date-of-birth fields, although the backend PROFILE_FIELDS accepts id_number and date_of_birth.

Opening /agent/me with no session hits the global axios 401 interceptor, which redirects to /login?expired=1&next=/agent/me (the unified login, which has no agent option) instead of /agent/login. Add an /agent prefix to the interceptor's onAuthPage check, or set _skipAuthRedirect on agentApi.me.
The toast uses `Agent ${action}d`, giving 'Agent clarifyd', 'Agent suspendd' and 'Agent rejectd'.
EscrowCoreForm.submit calls set('registered_address', …) and then onNext(). persist() reads the stale form closure, so registered_address is never saved (it is None in the DB).
Values typed in the first ~1-2s after load were wiped by a remount/hydration. The email field came back empty and the form showed 'Please fill out this field'. It works after waiting.

integration_issues.issue: Admin has no reinstate/unsuspend action. A suspended agent stays suspended for good.

issues: Licence expiry uses the browser's native date picker instead of the shadcn calendar
The step-0 button 'SAVE AND CONTINUE' (uppercase, inside the form) is styled differently from the 'Save & continue' buttons on steps 1-3

action_items: Keep the App.js fix: agent routes must stay outside RequireAdmin
Make Registration number optional (and skip the CIN regex) when entity_type is individual. Hide or relabel the escrow-only fields for agents. Add ID number and DOB for individuals.
Redirect an unauthenticated /agent/me to /agent/login, not to /login?expired
Return 404 for invalid ObjectIds in the admin agent endpoints
Harden the agent login lockout against a spoofed X-Forwarded-For
Fix the toast verbs and use email_sent in the Resend toast
Optional: add an unsuspend action and an owner check for agent-docs files
critical_code_review_comments: agents.py: ObjectId(aid) is called without validation in 4 endpoints
agents.py agent_login: the client-controlled XFF first hop is part of the lockout identifier
AgentPortal.persist sends the whole form (name, created_at, invited_by…). The server filters it with PROFILE_FIELDS, but an explicit payload would be cleaner
bid_opening._email_record: the fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task holds no reference, so the task can be garbage-collected. Keep a reference set (or use BackgroundTasks)

test_v64c: the actor_email restore in the tamper test was hardcoded to adminsupport. It broke once the background email task became the first record issuer, so the tester now restores the original actor

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows pass after the route fix; individual reg-number blocker remains)
